notes: Manuscript page 9, pencil 18. The author identifies the proposed isotopy relation with congruence under the identity-component automorphism groups, then explains why the previous canonical factorization no longer works after open inclusions are admitted: extra omitted source points and ramification values can move with the representative. The interlinear variables qualifies éléments f, not classe d’isotopie. The explanatory automorphism pair is Aut(Y-hat,T), with a clear forked Y. The text retains the mismatched parentheses around the S1 description, “une isomorphisme”, and “où Y′ est un morphisme fini”; these are source syntax, not repairs. The heavily revised insertion reads inclusions in the plural. The cancelled completion word may be the unusual complétifié; it is not securely compactifié. The author explicitly says “je ne vois plus comment” give an interpretation over the complex field in abstract algebraic geometry. This is a stated obstruction in his programme, not a non-existence theorem proved here.
doubts: The heavy cancellation obscures the original small circle.
The ending after t is partly overwritten; compactifié is disfavoured by the visible l-é.
